name: 18504 · Scranton, PA
findings: ZIP 18504 (Scranton) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18504 (Scranton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
